title: AI employees
description: What each one is responsible for, and how much of it they finish on their own.
unavailable: We couldn't read your AI employees just now.
noneBody: Until one exists, nobody is answering automatically — every message waits for a person.
noChannels: Not connected to any channel, so nothing reaches it.

pause.midConversation: {count, plural, =1 {One person is mid-conversation with it right now. They will simply stop getting replies — nobody is told, and the conversation is not passed to anyone.} other {# people are mid-conversation with it right now. They will simply stop getting replies — nobody is told, and the conversations are not passed to anyone.}}
pause.noneOpen: Nobody is mid-conversation right now. If someone writes in while it's paused, they'll get no reply and nobody will be told.

cannotFire: You can pause an AI employee and start it again. There is no way to retire one — GOTCHA has no such setting, so a paused employee stays in this list.

error.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this.

delete.live: {count, plural, =1 {One person is mid-conversation with it. They will stop getting replies and will wait unassigned until someone claims them.} other {# people are mid-conversation with it. They will stop getting replies and will wait unassigned until someone claims them.}}
delete.noneLive: Nobody is mid-conversation with it right now.
delete.historyKept: {count, plural, =1 {The one conversation it already finished keeps its record — deleting it doesn't unmake the work it did.} other {The # conversations it already finished keep their record — deleting it doesn't unmake the work it did.}}
delete.routing: New conversations will stop being sent to it.

deleted.done: {name} is gone. {released, plural, =0 {No conversation needed releasing.} =1 {One conversation was released and is waiting for someone to claim it.} other {# conversations were released and are waiting for someone to claim them.}}
